name: Cucco Strike
hook: Kick the pixel rooster once and prepare to face an avian apocalypse
tagline: A streamer clad in green tunic pokes a tiny harmless farm bird as feathers start to scatter. As the multiplier surges, skyward clouds darken with thousands of shrieking poultry locking in their flight vectors. Cashing out activates a smoke bomb roll into a haycart, while crashing triggers an inescapable pecking vortex that reduces the hero to pixel dust.
